tolerance_d: Two fixed tolerances per logit, S = sum_k |x_k*w_k| (fp64). Hard bound, any summation algorithm: tau_worst = K*2^-23*S + 2^-24*|ref| with K=4096 (bf16 x bf16 products are exact in fp32, 8+8 significand bits <= 24; K-1 fp32 additions, each <= 1 ulp even if truncating, first-order Higham gamma_{K-1}). Verification tolerance: tau_d = 2^-14*S + 2^-24*|ref|: a tensor-core GEMM with fp32 accumulators updates the accumulator K/16 = 256 times (<= 2^-15*S, one ulp each incl. truncation), doubled for the error inside each 16-product chunk and any split-K reduction. Pass = every corrected logit within tau_d and every corrected-vs-reference top-8 disagreement inside the margin band 0.5*max_e tau_d,e (sigmoid is 1/4-Lipschitz, the bias is common); within tau_worst but not tau_d = inconclusive; beyond tau_worst = wrong computation.
